runtime_scope: six internal v1 stages; currently fake backends; not native or submission acceptance
native_scope: proposed stage boundaries; adapters and native delivery schemas pending
role_policy: Roles float across members. Modules define capabilities and delivery contracts, not permanent people. No named module assignment is a prerequisite.
worker_policy: Any capable available member may execute any task. Record actual executor and environment per attempt; choose reviewers for the affected consumer scopes per result.
coordination_policy: Use a task-scoped coordination note before shared work, separate branches and unique run directories. Git notes are not a distributed lock or scheduler.
input_policy: Track 1 or independent synthetic fixtures only; immutable experiment input identities; no Track 2 derivatives
handoff_policy: Git stores small references and reviews; large artifacts use verified Release or team storage packages
